intent: 7-day weather forecast for Hong Kong with daily summaries and forecasts
global_desc: A 7-day weather report for Hong Kong organized by day, featuring a lead section with a summary and forecast, followed by a daily breakdown with key weather indicators and a visual representation of the forecast trends.

sections.title: Weather Summary
sections.desc: Hero section displaying the overall 7-day weather trend with key highlights such as average temperature, precipitation chance, and dominant weather conditions
sections.data_needed: city_name (text), forecast_period (text), avg_temperature (number), precipitation_chance (percent), dominant_weather (text), hero_image_url (url)

sections.title: Daily Forecast
sections.desc: Grid layout showing 7 days of detailed forecasts with key metrics like high/low temperatures, rainfall probability, wind speed, and recommended clothing
sections.data_needed: For each day: date (date), high_temp (number), low_temp (number), precipitation_chance (percent), wind_speed (number), recommended_clothing (text), icon (text), visibility (text), feels_like (number), sunrise_time (time), sunset_time (time)

sections.title: Weather Trends
sections.desc: Chronological view of weather patterns across the 7 days, highlighting significant changes and transitions
sections.data_needed: For each time slot: date (date), weather_condition (text), temperature_range (text), precipitation_chance (percent), icon (text), notes (text, optional)
